biocs.name: Abnormal Process Connection to Meterpreter Port
biocs.description: A process makes an outbound connection to port 4444, which is the default Meterpreter C2 port
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 4444
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual Process Connection to Default Meterpreter Port
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a non-system process connects to the default Meterpreter C2 port
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 4444
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name not in ('svchost.exe', 'explorer.exe', 'wsmprovhost.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect Outbound Connection to Meterpreter Port
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 4444
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, dst_ip, dst_port
